collections.name: Spring Sakura Collection
collections.tagline: Japanese woodblock waves, blossom scatter, ink-line calm.
collections.description: Inspired by spring in the floating world — flat sun discs, wave curls, and floating cherry blossom embroidery across heavyweight fleece, combed cotton, and raw canvas.

collections.name: Royal Heritage Collection
collections.tagline: Arches, jaals and royal court processions in gold zardozi.
collections.description: Arch lattices, elephant processions, and intricate jaal geometry drawn from royal court lineages, rendered in metallic zari, raw silk, and fine needlework.

collections.name: Midnight Atelier Collection
collections.tagline: No world, just pure cloth, heroic crests, and tonal needlecraft.
collections.description: Universe-neutral and nocturnal luxury pieces — sashiko grids, crewel relief, comic noir geometry, and understated crest detailing on heavyweight unbleached and charcoal yarns.
